questions.createWorkspace: How do I create a workspace?
questions.createWorkspaceAnswer: Create a workspace from the workspace switcher, then invite your team and choose a plan.
questions.inviteTeammatesAnswer: Open Workspace settings, select Members, and send an invitation to each teammate's work email.
questions.multipleWorkspacesAnswer: Yes. Use the workspace switcher in the sidebar to create and move between workspaces.
questions.viewInvoicesAnswer: Open Profile and select Billing to review your recent invoices.
questions.changePlanAnswer: You can review your current plan in the Billing section of your Profile.
questions.paymentMethods: Which payment methods can I use?
questions.paymentMethodsAnswer: Workspace billing supports major credit and debit cards. Manage saved payment methods from billing settings.
questions.resetPassword: How do I reset my password?
questions.resetPasswordAnswer: Use Forgot password on the sign-in page. We will send a secure reset link to your account email.
questions.enableTwoFactor: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
questions.enableTwoFactorAnswer: Open your Profile settings, go to Security, and turn on two-factor authentication.
questions.signOutDevices: How can I sign out of other devices?
questions.signOutDevicesAnswer: Use Active Sessions in Profile → Security to review and end sessions.
questions.assignTask: How do I assign a task?
questions.assignTaskAnswer: Open Tasks, choose a task, and select a teammate in the assignee field.
questions.projectAccessAnswer: Project owners can update member roles and permissions from project settings.
questions.teamActivity: Where can I find team activity?
questions.teamActivityAnswer: Open the project activity view to see recent changes, comments, and status updates.
